scope: Targeted second-pass reading of Advent, Nativity, carols, Nativity decorations and Christmas foods. Source-located nested variants and potential unindexed customs, not an exhaustive full-page certification.

source_corpus.author: Francis X. Weiser S.J.
source_corpus.title: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs

notes: All source details are individually described in Weiser's public 1958 text. Original printed pages and public OCR line offsets provided. Provisional specificity/identity is not evidence of current use. Author's non-Catholic / comparative practices and superstition accounts are deliberately flagged. No wholesale page text reproduced.
